genius.notes: Reviewed October 7, 2026. Published terms identify Anzens Inc., a Delaware company, and specify KYC-gated mint/redemption and fiat withdrawal, including separate arrangements for foreign entities. The AML statement claims alignment with the GENIUS Act and close regulator cooperation but names no qualification route, PPSI application or approval; this general alignment claim is not upgraded to issuer-announced-intent. Partner disclosure calls Anzens a FinCEN MSB; registration was not independently verified and supplies no PPSI authority. The previously asserted 17 state no-objection letters were not verified and are removed. The public Anzens January attestation post contains a five-page independent accountant examination; its LinkedIn-hosted transcript was opened. The Network Firm LLP signed February 9, 2026, examining January 31 reserves of $12,079,477 against 11,728,518 USDA. Reserves consisted of $11,965,192 Superstate Short Duration U.S. Government Securities Fund shares held directly by Anzens and $114,285 dollars with BitGo custody. ReserveDisclosurePresent is corrected to true using the stable issuer publication URL; monthlyAttestationPresent records the publicly available monthly report and issuer-published monthly cadence claim. No later monthly reserve report was located, so these flags do not assert current October reserve coverage or uninterrupted cadence. The report expressly excludes examination of legal/regulatory compliance. Its custody naming is preserved as historical report wording; the whole reserve portfolio must not be described as cash held at BitGo. No token-specific GENIUS authorization or enforcement action was located in the bounded opened official/issuer corpus.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No token-specific PPSI approval, GENIUS state qualification, official PPSI application or registered foreign exception was located for Anzens Inc./USDA in the checked corpus. The issuer AML page asserts regulatory alignment without a qualification route or filed application. MSB status and an off-ramp partner foreign license do not evidence PPSI authorization. Negative authorization and action findings are limited to reviewed public sources, not every register or private filing.
